title: Harnessing the Universal Geometry of Embeddings
note: Poster, San Diego, Dec 5 2025. arXiv v1 2025-05-18; v4 2026-01-26 (updated abstract/tables). CC BY 4.0. Code: https://github.com/rjha18/vec2vec. This report verified every citation of Tables 2, 3, 5, 6, 7 and Appendices A, C, D, E against the full text. The abstract reports a cosine of 0.96 not reproduced in body or tables, so this report uses 0.92 only.

title: mini-vec2vec: Scaling Universal Geometry Alignment with Linear Transformations
note: Independent researcher; preprint with no conference publication attached. v1 2025-09-27; v4 2026-02-17. CC BY 4.0. Code: https://github.com/guy-dar/mini-vec2vec. Measures translation accuracy only — includes no inversion or attribute-inference experiments.

title: Text Embeddings Reveal (Almost) As Much As Text
note: Earlier inversion work from the same authors; source of the noise-injection defense figures in Section 6.

title: Universal Zero-shot Embedding Inversion
note: ZSInvert, the zero-shot inverter that Jha et al. 2025 uses as-is. All three authors are also co-authors of that paper. No conference publication found.

title: Rethinking the Privacy of Text Embeddings: A Reproducibility Study of "Text Embeddings Reveal (Almost) As Much As Text"
note: Source of the quantization defense figures in Section 6.

title: Eguard (AAAI) and the selective dimension perturbation family (SPARSE, DPPN, TextCrafter)

author.literal: Multiple authors — see note for individual attribution

note: Bundled reference for four defense papers behind the Section 6.2 comparison table, none independently replicated and none evaluated against vec2vec's threat model: (1) Eguard — Tiantian Liu, Hongwei Yao, Feng Lin, Tong Wu, Zhan Qin, Kui Ren, "Eguard: Defending LLM Embeddings Against Inversion Attacks via Text Mutual Information Optimization," AAAI-25 (arXiv:2411.05034, posted 2024-11-06; AAAI page: https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/40876). (2) TextCrafter — Duoxun Tang, Xinhang Jiang, Jiajun Niu, "TextCrafter: Optimization-Calibrated Noise for Defending Against Text Embedding Inversion" (arXiv:2509.17302, posted 2025-09-22). (3) SPARSE — Yu-Che Tsai, Hsiang Hsiao, Kuan-Yu Chen, Shou-De Lin, "Concept-Aware Privacy Mechanisms for Defending Embedding Inversion Attacks" (arXiv:2602.07090, posted 2026-02-06). (4) DPPN — "Detecting and Perturbing Privacy-Sensitive Neurons to Defend Embedding Inversion Attacks" (OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=DF5TVzpTW0) — author identities unconfirmed; page was under anonymous double-blind review at time of citation.

title: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis
note: The hypothesis Jha et al. 2025 sets out to extend; originally raised about vision models. Project page: https://phillipi.github.io/prh/

title: Effect of Cloaked AI on Search Accuracy
note: Vendor's own benchmark; source of the precision-loss figures for application-layer vector encryption in Section 6.2. Publication date not versioned on the page; year approximate.

title: 'Rosetta stone' for database inputs reveals serious security issue
note: Source of the author interview. Shmatikov: "Everybody should think of these embeddings as being as sensitive as the underlying text."

title: Open Chroma Databases: A New Attack Surface for AI Apps
note: Survey finding 406 of 1,170 internet-exposed Chroma instances returned data. Methodology published; covers Chroma only.

title: The AI Data You Forgot to Lock: How Exposed Vector Databases Put Organizations at Risk
note: Reports exposed instances across Weaviate, Milvus, ChromaDB, and Qdrant without disclosing counts.

title: CVE-2025-64513 (Milvus proxy authentication bypass) and CVE-2026-45829 (ChromaDB pre-auth remote code execution)
note: CVE-2025-64513: Milvus Proxy authentication bypass via forged sourceId header, CVSS 9.3, disclosed 2025-11-10 (GHSA-mhjq-8c7m-3f7p). CVE-2026-45829 ("ChromaToast"): pre-authentication remote code execution in ChromaDB's Python FastAPI server via malicious Hugging Face model loading, reported by HiddenLayer: https://www.hiddenlayer.com/research/chromatoast-served-pre-auth

title: Opinion 28/2024 on certain data protection aspects related to the processing of personal data in the context of AI models
note: Lists inversion attacks and membership inference among the considerations for an AI model anonymity determination. Its object is the model, not stored embeddings.

title: EDPS v Single Resolution Board, Case C-413/23 P

author.literal: Court of Justice of the European Union

note: Source of the "means reasonably likely to be used" test for re-identification; holds that pseudonymised data is not personal data for every recipient.

title: 가명정보 처리 가이드라인 (Pseudonymised Data Processing Guidelines), full revision
note: Shift to a risk-based framework and introduction of sample review for unstructured data. No mention of the status of embedding vectors was found.
